regionalEastWest.unmapped_values: Any other value, including DE, DEZ, DEP or finer NUTS code, remains unclassified; stop this grouping for incompatible German regional metadata instead of prefix guessing.

Country report rules out federal-state representativity; no separate representative state profile. East/west domains still need design precision and scope checks.

lr_approx_weighted_thirds.unlock_after: fixed and reviewed model, scoring, labels and grouping algorithm; no LR answers before that gate
lr_approx_weighted_thirds.reference_for_cutpoints: All Germany15+ cases meeting fixed design eligibility and valid lrscale, before conditioning on score-item completeness; analysis weight anweight
lr_approx_weighted_thirds.algorithm: For every integer pair0<=a<b<=9 with positive weighted mass in0..a,a+1..b,b+1..10, calculate L=(F(a)-1/3)^2+(F(b)-2/3)^2. Choose minimum L; exact ties choose lexicographically smallest(a,b). Save a,b once; preserve every whole category tie. If no feasible pair or nonpositive/nonfinite weights, suppress this grouping. Do not tune to scores, party results or precision.
lr_approx_weighted_thirds.interpretation: Approximately weighted thirds of self-placement, not equal sized groups, party blocs or named ideology dimensions. Numerical cutpoints are still unknown.

historical_second_vote.structural_missing: 66 Not applicable is kept distinct; B14 is asked only when vote1. vote2 includes invalid/blank ballots per national interviewer instruction. vote3 means not eligible.
historical_second_vote.other55: Heterogeneous other-party category; no invented party name or single ideology. Gate/suppress separately.
historical_second_vote.first_vote_policy: prtvgde1 is B14a first vote for candidate-party, not substituted or pooled with second vote.
historical_second_vote.consistency_rule: Named party/Other with vote!=1 is a filter inconsistency; quarantine/error for this grouping. No vote imputation from party field.
historical_second_vote.interpretation: Retrospective self-reported second vote at Bundestag electionSeptember2021, interviewedMay–December2023. No current electorate, voting intention, verified vote or electoral population claim.

missing_policy.empty_or_null: unclassified system missing; distinct from named response nonresponse codes; never zero or midpoint
missing_policy.unknown_codes: fail schema QA for that field; do not import questionnaire refusal codes into integrated4.2 silently
missing_policy.nonresponse_separation: Retain refusal, dont-know, no-answer, not-available, not-applicable and substantive-unclassifiable statuses until disclosure-reviewed aggregation; no response rows exported
missing_policy.score_domain: Identical fixed nine-item complete-response mask for the first proposed comparison. Missing group value excludes only that group-family domain; it does not change another grouping or the national model dataset.
missing_policy.population_claim: Without separately supported response/missing assumptions, descriptive statistics describe the historical complete-response domain. Design intervals do not cure nonresponse or recall bias.

descriptive_response_means.candidate: Fixed observed0–1 scores or individual response means, design weighted ratio estimates and full shared-PSU covariance; label as historical reported responses.
requires: human product/text approval of narrow descriptive display
descriptive_response_means.does_not_require_for_its_narrow_estimand: Latent construct comparability is not asserted. This alternative needs an explicit scope decision, not an automatic product replacement.

construct_or_latent_profiles.current_status: not approved; candidate full-strict model-conditional path below; suppress if its prerequisites/gates fail
requires: valid full cross-group moment covariance and joint inference
full strict ordinal restriction stages correctly parameterised and tested
pre-fixed all-item strict common-metric link and its limitations, no answer-selected anchors
positive equivalence of unrestricted configural curves after strict-model linking, with full joint covariance of both fits
adequate group information and calibrated precision
construct_or_latent_profiles.external_anchor_status: No externally validated ESS anchor is established. Full strict identified invariance remains testable as a model-conditional restriction system; lack of external anchors does not by itself block that standard conditional path.
construct_or_latent_profiles.identification_limit: Common affine shifts/scales affecting all items can be observationally indistinguishable from latent factor mean/variance shifts. Passing strict restrictions and curve equivalence cannot resolve this or establish absolute population construct equality.
construct_or_latent_profiles.partial_invariance_policy: No partial-invariance rescue or answer-selected invariant anchor if full strict gates fail; suppress affected construct comparison, retain justified descriptive response means only.
forbidden_shortcuts: fully equal model score functions imply empirical equivalence
synthetic anchors imply valid ESS anchors
partial scalar invariance justifies observed ordinal score means automatically

precision_candidates.origin: Own product precision budgets, not literature cutoffs or passed requirements. Coordinator decides before dependent access; minimum count alone does not pass.

method_gap_candidate.status: mathematical implementation proposal; no new model-fit test implemented or calibrated in this source package
method_gap_candidate.joint_covariance: Stack group moment influence contributions, sum inside original shared PSU, centre within original stratum; retain full crossblocks in V_m and zero contributions for empty domains.
method_gap_candidate.parameter_sandwich: With public D=lavTech(fit,delta), tangent basisZ from linear equality constraints and exact fittingW, A=DZ; K_theta=(A^T W A)^-1 A^T W; K_beta=Z K_theta; V_beta=K_beta V_m K_beta^T. Check order, rank, normalization and admissibility first.
method_gap_candidate.joint_fit: P=I-AK; Q=r^TWr; U=P^TWP. Under first-order joint normal moment approximation, Q has law sum_l lambda_l*chi_square1, lambda eigenvalues of V_m^(1/2) U V_m^(1/2). Preserve crossblocks; no inversion of V_m and no naive native scaled chi-square subtraction.
method_gap_candidate.numerical_option: Gaussian/eigenvalue simulation with declared seed/draw count and binomial Monte Carlo interval, or verified quadratic-form CDF. Approximation to survey sampling remains asymptotic; do not call exact finite-sample ESS test.
method_gap_candidate.joint_restrictions: For testable equality contrasts in correctly identified common parameterization, joint Wald q=c(theta)^T [C V_theta C^T]^-1 c(theta), chi_square_rank limit; rank deficient or unidentifiable contrast blocks the test. Do not include mere identification restrictions as tested substantives.
method_gap_candidate.nested_fit_option: With same fixed W and nested moment manifolds, compare Q_restricted-Q_unrestricted. Under restricted null evaluate both tangent spaces at its same implied-moment point after exact reparameterisation; eigenvalues of V_m^(1/2)(U_restricted-U_unrestricted)V_m^(1/2) give first-order weighted-chi-square law. Verify tangent nesting and positive-semidefinite difference; do not subtract independently scaled native tests.
method_gap_candidate.ordinal_identification: semTools0.5-9 measEq.syntax ID.catWu.Estabrook.2016, THETA, std.lv; regenerate each stage threshold/loading/intercept/residual constraints and release no-longer-needed identification constraints. Wu does not solve arbitrary partial invariance.

conditional_unrestricted_curve_equivalen.fits: Unrestricted identified configuralC and full strictS on same moments and groups; reference group fixed before answers; reference factor mean0/variance1, other strict factor means/variances free.
conditional_unrestricted_curve_equivalen.curve: At fixed common eta=x, evaluate configural group curve at z_g=(x-mu_g_strict)/sqrt(psi_g_strict), using that group configural thresholds/loadings/intercept/residual normalization. Form observed0–1 score curve and all predetermined group-pair differences.
conditional_unrestricted_curve_equivalen.why_not_tautology: Only mu/psi linking comes from strictS. Item functions come from unrestrictedC; strict equality does not force these configural curve differences to0.
conditional_unrestricted_curve_equivalen.joint_delta: Stack K_beta_C and K_beta_S and compute V_stack=K_stack V_m K_stack^T, including between-fit covariance. Differentiate contrasts through configural item parameters and strict mu/sqrt(psi); no independent-fit SE.
conditional_unrestricted_curve_equivalen.positive_gate_candidate: For all pre-fixed group-pair/retained-score/raster contrasts compute U=max(|Delta|+t_(1-.05/(2L),design_df)*SE). Require U<.05, adequate information, valid calibration and full strict fit/restriction gates. Margin/raster are own conditional display budgets, not literature thresholds. No claim outside raster.
conditional_unrestricted_curve_equivalen.scope: Conditional on strict all-item linking and chosen normal-probit structure. Common affine DIF remains unidentifiable, and evidence beyond the measured content is not claimed.
